title: Theorem Learner: proofs from concepts to results
summary: The data of the Theorems notebook on the site: proofs from basic concepts to advanced results. Each theorem has its exact statement and one or more separate proofs, each showing how its hypotheses feed its steps and conclusion, with concept reminders and a theory graph that joins concepts, proof mechanisms, proofs and theorems. This folder keeps the authored learning data and its Rust builder, which writes raw.json from it and the Theorem Explorer's catalog.
